Frequently Asked Questions

What is the actual GPU TGP wattage of Lenovo Legion Slim 5 (16APH8) RTX 4060?

The Lenovo Legion Slim 5 (16APH8) RTX 4060 features a 140W Max TGP (Lenovo LA1 AI Chip + MUX Switch) rating for its NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 8GB GDDR6. This ensures stable framerates without thermal throttling under sustained gaming loads.

Can I upgrade the RAM and SSD on this laptop?

Yes! It has 2x SO-DIMM slots (Expandable up to 32GB) and 2x M.2 2280 PCIe 4.0 slots. You can easily drop in an additional 16GB RAM stick or high-speed Gen4 NVMe SSD at home without voiding warranty.

Is this laptop recommended for programming, coding, and college?

Lenovo Legion Slim 5 (16APH8) RTX 4060 scores 9.9/10 for software engineering. Its AMD Ryzen 7 7840HS (8 Cores, 16 Threads, up to 5.1 GHz, Zen 4) easily handles Docker, multiple IDEs, compiling code, and virtual machines.
